conceptual_change: Introduce a stateful execution engine that buffers the last two SMA values to detect cross-over points for triggering market orders exactly when the 50-period SMA transitions from below to above the 200-period SMA (and vice versa) on the 1h timeframe.
rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected because it lacked a concrete implementation mechanism for the order execution logic. This hypothesis addresses the rejection by formalizing the state-based detection required to execute the crossover strategy.
